query.comment: S1 Deadlock-free
S2 Per-battery ammo non-negative

query.formula: A[] (usedU_b[0] <= CH_PER_U && usedU_b[1] <= CH_PER_U && usedL_b[0] <= CH_PER_L && usedL_b[1] <= CH_PER_L)
query.comment: S3 Per-battery channel usage within capacity

query.formula: A[] (inflU <= NB_U * CH_PER_U && inflL <= NB_L * CH_PER_L)
query.comment: S4 Total in-flight per layer bounded by total channel capacity
S5 Multi-battery conflict-free (upper): at most one upper battery per threat
S6 Multi-battery conflict-free (lower): at most one lower battery per threat
S7 No double-counting of terminal threats
S8 Layered cap: at most one upper + one lower per threat
T1 Planner period deadline
T2 Engagement-window invariant
L1 Every threat eventually terminates
L2 Every Live threat eventually reaches a terminal state
R1 Full-intercept run is reachable under the GreedyWTA policy
R2 Simultaneous upper + lower engagement reachable
R3 Same threat hit by upper AND lower (layered defence)
R4 Leakage reachable (saturation under the GreedyWTA policy)
P1 No upper interceptor is ever wasted on a threat that has not entered the upper band
P2 No lower interceptor is ever wasted on a threat that has not entered the lower band
P3 Per-battery used counters are consistent with the global inflU counter
P4 Per-battery used counters are consistent with the global inflL counter
P5 Both upper batteries can be busy simultaneously (load is distributed across L-SAMs)
